newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD to invest 100 bln yen in undersea cable--paper.
newsitem.headline: KDD to invest 100 bln yen in undersea cable--paper.

text.p: International telecommunications operator Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) will invest about 100 billion yen in laying an undersea optical fibre cable around three of Japan's main islands by the summer of 1999, a Japanese newspaper said on Tuesday.
The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the move was in line with KDD's wish to enter domestic telephone services.
The 8,500 km cable to loop around the islands of Honshu, Shikoku and Kyushu will have a capacity of 100 gigabits, or 1.2 million phone lines, the paper said.
A KDD spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
